results.title: CodeGraph: Pre-indexed code knowledge graph for coding agents
results.summary: Open-source local-first tool (npm/CLI/MCP server) that builds a pre-indexed semantic code knowledge graph from a codebase and exposes it to agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex to cut tokens and tool calls. Heavily trending (~64.5k stars), with a benchmark re-validation dated 2026-07-21.

results.title: LLM Agents Can See Code Repositories
results.summary: First systematic empirical study of visual repository representations (folder hierarchies, dependency graphs) for LLM coding agents on issue resolution; accepted to ASE 2026, revised 2026-08-03. Finds a hybrid text-plus-vision design can cut input tokens up to 26% while maintaining accuracy.

results.title: WebDesignIter: Co-Evolving Design Knowledge for Repository-Level Front-End Code Generation
results.summary: Framework centered on a persistent knowledge graph (WebAppArchKG) fusing repository structure with design knowledge for repository-level front-end code generation, reporting +9.55 pp Pass@2 gains on Web-Bench and showing design knowledge is the most critical component.

results.title: RepoDoc: A Knowledge Graph-Based Framework to Automatic Documentation Generation and Incremental Updates
results.summary: Uses a repository knowledge graph (RepoKG) as the semantic foundation for documentation generation and incremental updates, with a semantic impact propagation mechanism to find affected parts on code changes; evaluated on 24 repositories across 8 languages.

results.title: RANGER -- Repository-Level Agent for Graph-Enhanced Retrieval
results.summary: Repository-level retrieval agent that builds a knowledge graph capturing cross-file dependencies down to the variable level, then uses Cypher lookups for entity queries and MCTS-guided graph exploration for natural-language queries; evaluated on CodeSearchNet, RepoQA, RepoBench, and CrossCodeEval.

results.title: Knowledge Graph Based Repository-Level Code Generation
results.summary: Represents code repositories as knowledge graphs to capture structural and relational information for context-aware code generation, using hybrid code retrieval to track inter-file dependencies; outperforms baselines on EvoCodeBench.

results.title: RepoGraph: Enhancing AI Software Engineering with Repository-level Code Graph
results.summary: Foundational plug-in module (ICLR 2025) that parses a repository into a line-level code graph and uses sub-graph retrieval to give LLM agents repository-wide navigation, setting a new state of the art among open-source frameworks on SWE-bench.
